title: Copycat on speculative data
attack: A bot subscribes to the speculative monadLogs feed and tries to copy a claim. Naive registry (fingerprint in the claim) versus Touchplate (hidden commitment).
outcome: Naive mode leaked the fingerprint on the Proposed feed 3773 ms after the victim sent it; the bot copied it 5324 ms after submission and landed in block 113144951 versus the victim's block 113144942; first claimant on chain: the victim. Touchplate's touch exposed only a Merkle root; the bot's reveal attempt reverted (reverted).

txs.label: victim claim(pdq) on the naive registry: fingerprint is public in the claiming tx
bot copies the leaked fingerprint into its own claim
bot tries to reveal against the victim's root (status reverted; NotAuthor)

data.honestNote: On a healthy chain the copier cannot overtake an already-proposed block; the exposure is the fingerprint itself and the abandoned-block and same-block cases, which a hidden commitment removes.
